{{Quote|This popular sandwich boasts sliced Manpha-fowl, nuna bacon, Revwien lettuce and topato. Served on toasted or therm-zapped pseudograin bread.|Dex's Diner menu, on the Shawda Clubb sandwich|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Pseudograin bread''' was a type of [[Bread/Legends|bread]] at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Restaurant/Legends|diner]] served various [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwiches]] on the customer's choice of either toasted or therm-zapped pseudograin bread including its [[Besh-Leth-Trill sandwich]], [[deluxe nutmeat and jelly sandwich]], [[gartro egg salad sandwich]], [[hot gizka sandwich]], [[shaak and cheese sandwich]], and [[Shawda Clubb sandwich]]. Dex's Diner also sold a [[nerfsteak sandwich]] on a [[pseudograin roll]] and offered pseudograin rolls with its dinner favorites which included its hot gizka sandwich.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pseudograin bread was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
